scope: installed-valve beta.10 on-air discriminator after beta.11 candidates 9 through 11 were silent
findings: The selected closest Vegetable Garden Radio physically emitted the exact candidate-9 command frame built by the gateway.
The decoded route, companion endpoint, counter, Zone 1 selector, 60-second payload, trailer, polarity, carrier, and FSK separation are internally coherent.
The same logical candidate was silent on beta.10 as it had been on beta.11, so beta.11's bounded repeated-burst implementation is not the cause.
This eliminates a missing node transmission and gross on-air payload or carrier corruption from the leading hypotheses.

The remaining leading explanations are retained valve command state outside candidate 9 through 11, or a valve-side association/control acceptance condition not represented by routine telemetry. Silence is not evidence for advancing the counter.
